description.en: The Valencian Community is an autonomous community of Spain. It is the fourth most populous Spanish autonomous community after Andalusia, Catalonia and the Community of Madrid with more than 5 million inhabitants.
description.zh-CN: 華倫西亞自治区是西班牙的一個自治區，位於西班牙東南部。1238年至1707年曾為瓦倫西亞王國。
